name: cloud-clipboard
description: A real-time cloud clipboard application with secure room-based sharing, automatic file management, and modern PWA features

scripts.build: bun run icons:generate && bun run client:build
scripts.test: bun run shared:test && bun run client:test
scripts.rust:coverage: docker run --rm --security-opt seccomp=unconfined --cap-add SYS_PTRACE -v cargo-registry:/usr/local/cargo/registry -v $(pwd)/server-rust:/app -w /app cloud-clipboard-rust-coverage cargo tarpaulin --all-features --out Stdout --out Html --out Lcov --output-dir /app/coverage
scripts.rust:coverage:ci: docker run --rm --security-opt seccomp=unconfined --cap-add SYS_PTRACE -v cargo-registry:/usr/local/cargo/registry -v $(pwd)/server-rust:/app -w /app cloud-clipboard-rust-coverage cargo tarpaulin --all-features --out Xml --out Lcov --output-dir /app/coverage
scripts.test:coverage:all: bun run client:test:coverage && bun run rust:coverage
scripts.validate: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run type-check && bun run test
scripts.validate:ci: bun run type-check && bun run test
scripts.validate:quick: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run type-check
